attributes.description: Authentication and access overview for Snowflake login history and sessions. ACCOUNT_USAGE data may lag 45 minutes to 3 hours.

query.esql:
FROM logs-snowflake.sessions-*
| EVAL closed = CASE(snowflake.sessions.is_open == false, 1, 0)
| STATS ever_closed = MAX(closed) BY snowflake.sessions.session_id
| WHERE ever_closed == 0
| STATS open_sessions = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snowflake.sessions-*
| EVAL closed = CASE(snowflake.sessions.is_open == false, 1, 0)
| STATS ever_closed = MAX(closed) BY snowflake.sessions.session_id
| WHERE ever_closed == 0
| STATS open_sessions = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snowflake.login_history-*
| EVAL day_of_week = CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT("e", @timestamp), " ", DATE_FORMAT("EEE", @timestamp)),
       hour_of_day = DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp)
| STATS logins = COUNT(*) BY day_of_week, hour_of_day

FROM logs-snowflake.login_history-*
| EVAL day_of_week = CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT("e", @timestamp), " ", DATE_FORMAT("EEE", @timestamp)),
       hour_of_day = DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp)
| STATS logins = COUNT(*) BY day_of_week, hour_of_day

embeddableConfig.title: Login Activity by Week and Hour (UTC)

params.markdown:
This dashboard covers authentication and access for the Snowflake integration. It summarizes login 
attempts over time, login locations, activity by time of day and day of week, and counters for active sessions and failed logins.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/snowflake/overview)**
